title: W10901168 — Bella Diagnostics entry
description: Eyebrow UI diagnostics — Recommended + Drawer hold 5 s.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Bella 32 cu ft French Door Refrigerator (W10901168, WRF992/993/995)

steps.title: Enter Diagnostics
steps.body: Hold Recommended + Drawer 5 s (chime, lights out). Up/Down navigate; Icemaker2 select; Fast Cool back; test 00 or 20 min timeout to exit.
